text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS. Spectators 
whisper that for a short-distance runner 
like Mihono Bourbon, a Triple Crown bid 
might be too far a stretch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, even while Mihono Bourbon faced 
harsh public criticism, Rice Shower 
cheered her on as she took on the 
challenge, saying, "Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon headed into her 
race, determined to fulfill the order that 
would leave the entire world convinced.
